verdict.rationale: The Entity API docs show a separate api-alpha.sam.gov endpoint, which suggests a non-production test environment distinct from the main API. The pack never describes it as a sandbox or says it isolates users from production data, so the capability is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a sandbox/test environment, a statement that alpha uses non-production or synthetic data, guidance on getting test keys or accounts, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
